evidence.title: https://datamatrixmedical.com/tandem-ai-prior-authorization-reviews-compared-to-prior-authorization-specialists/
evidence.text: Editor’s Update, July 2026 Tandem AI has rebranded as Forus. The name change follows a $160 million funding round that valued the company at $1 billion. The medication prior authorization automation platform discussed throughout this review is the same product, now operating under the Forus name at try.forus.com . The comparison below reflects DataMatrix Medical’s independent assessment of the platform’s capabilities, which remain accurate to the product itself under its new name. The Review Tandem AI represents a new generation of clinical documentation and workflow automation platforms. Their technology uses AI-driven tools to auto-generate notes, streamline documentation, and support “portions” of the prior authorization workflow, making it appealing to practices seeking speed and automation. According to Reddit reviews , Tandem appears to be good at biologics and branded topicals (Opzelura, Vtama, etc.), and cases can be easily submitted through a portal. However, healthcare operations rely on more than speed. They require accuracy, clinical judgment, payer nuance, communication, and accountability, areas where automation alone often struggles. In the case of DataMatrix Medical vs Tandem AI , DataMatrix will handle ALL prior authorizations, end-to-end submissions, and phone calls, which still account for about 20% of all authorization approvals, equaling thousands of dollars in lost revenue. That’s why many practices turn to DataMatrix Medical, an official AAOE Peer Review Program ™ vendor for Prior Authorization Services . With 99%+ accuracy, <1% denial rates, and full-spectrum support across prior authorization, billing, and virtual medical assistants, DataMatrix brings a level of experience and reliability that technology alone cannot match. To clarify where both companies align and where they differ most, it’s helpful to step back and compare their offerings side by side. The comparison below provides a clear, at-a-glance view of how Tandem AI’s automation-first approach contrasts with DataMatrix Medical’s experience-driven, people-powered support model. evidence.text: Tandem AI prescription startup just achieved a remarkable $1 billion valuation, cementing its position among health tech unicorns 2026 and marking a watershed moment for AI in pharmacy innovation. This New York-based company has quietly transformed how physicians navigate the labyrinthine world of prior authorizations, medication affordability, and pharmacy coordination—all while attracting unprecedented healthcare AI startup funding. The milestone reflects surging investor confidence in companies addressing America’s prescription access crisis. Tandem uses AI to handle prior authorizations, affordability, and pharmacy coordination for every prescription, directly tackling bottlenecks that delay patient care and frustrate medical providers nationwide. How Tandem AI Prescription Startup Is Disrupting Healthcare Traditional prescription fulfillment feels archaic. Doctors prescribe medications. Insurance companies demand prior authorization. Patients wait days or weeks. Many abandon treatment entirely due to cost barriers or administrative exhaustion. Tandem is solving a complex and critical challenge in healthcare: prescription access, with their AI-powered software platform transforming how providers navigate prior authorizations, access barriers, and specialty drug workflows. The platform integrates seamlessly into existing medical workflows, automatically checking insurance coverage, identifying the most affordable pharmacy options, and submitting necessary documentation without physician intervention. The Tandem Technology valuation surge to $1 billion demonstrates that investors recognize medication access as more than a technical problem—it’s a fundamental barrier to equitable healthcare. Every delayed prescription represents a potential health crisis, whether it’s life-saving insulin or critical cardiac medications. Understanding Tandem $1 Billion Funding and Market Positioning The healthcare AI startup funding landscape experienced explosive growth in 2025, with AI-enabled digital health companies capturing 54% of total funding, up from 37% last year. Tandem rode this wave perfectly by addressing concrete pain points that resonate with both healthcare providers and payers. Why did Tandem $1 billion funding happen now? Several converging forces created perfect conditions: Prior authorization burden reached breaking points across medical practices Specialty medication costs spiraled beyond patient affordability Regulatory pressure mounted to streamline medication access AI capabilities matured sufficiently to handle complex pharmacy workflows Tandem’s founder Sahir Jaggi leveraged deep experience as a Product Leader at Oscar Health for six years, bringing insider knowledge of insurance complexities and healthcare technology integration. This expertise proved invaluable when designing AI prescription automation that actually works in real-world clinical settings. evidence.title: https://www.openevidence.com/announcements/openevidence-and-tandem-partner-to-streamline-evidence-based-prescribing-and-prior-authorizations
evidence.text: OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patient MIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications. This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment. OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients. Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access. “Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.” “As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.” By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered. Tandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treatment faster, medical staff get their time back, and providers can prescribe what they believe is best. Embedded directly into EHR workflows, Tandem automates every prior authorization from prescription to approval—generating appeals, routing prescriptions to the right pharmacy, and enrolling patients in savings and support programs to prev

evidence.text: Forus Forus using AI to accelerate access to medicine. We are building the world’s largest network of doctors, patients and first-party data and applying AI to every step of bringing new therapies to market. Forus + Pear We met Forus’s founder, Sahir Jaggi after discovering mutual connections through our Pear Healthcare Council, including Mario Schlosser, the founder of Oscar Health. Sahir’s deep experience as a Product Leader at Oscar for six years made an immediate impression on us. We believed in his vision from day one and invested in their seed round in 2023. Forus is solving a complex and critical challenge in healthcare: prescription access. Their AI-powered software platform is transforming how providers navigate prior authorizations, access barriers, and specialty drug workflows. Today, Forus’s solution supports thousands of patients every week and is widely recognized as a leading platform in the space. Since our investment, we have worked closely with Sahir, helping Forus with customer and advisor introductions as well supporting their Series A raise. Our Talent team has also partnered with them post-Series A to help strategically scale their organization. We have played an active role in sourcing, engaging, and converting top-tier candidates for their growing team. We’re proud to support Forus as they build the infrastructure to make prescription access seamless, intelligent, and patient-first. evidence.text: OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patient MIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications. This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment. OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients. Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access. “Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.” “As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.” By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered. Tandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treatment faster, medical staff get their time back, and providers can prescribe what they believe is best. evidence.text: OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patient MIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications. This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment. OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients. Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access. “Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.” “As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.” By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered. Tandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treatment faster, medical staff get their time back, and providers can prescribe what they believe is best. evidence.text: OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patient MIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications. This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment. OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients. Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access. “Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.” “As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.” By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered. Tandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treatment faster, medical staff get their time back, and providers can prescribe what they believe is best. evidence.text: Editor’s Update, July 2026 Tandem AI has rebranded as Forus. The name change follows a $160 million funding round that valued the company at $1 billion. Their technology uses AI-driven tools to auto-generate notes, streamline documentation, and support “portions” of the prior authorization workflow, making it appealing to practices seeking speed and automation. According to Reddit reviews , Tandem appears to be good at biologics and branded topicals (Opzelura, Vtama, etc.), and cases can be easily submitted through a portal. However, healthcare operations rely on more than speed. They require accuracy, clinical judgment, payer nuance, communication, and accountability, areas where automation alone often struggles. evidence.text: OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patient MIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications. This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment. OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients. Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access. “Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. evidence.text: OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patient MIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications. This collaboration directly connects evidence-based clinical decision-making with seamless prescription generation and prior authorization submission. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment. OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients. Together, the two platforms close one of healthcare’s most critical gaps: turning the right clinical decision into immediate patient access. “Clinicians shouldn’t have to choose between delivering care and navigating administrative complexity,” said Ania Bilski, MD, VP of Clinical AI at OpenEvidence. “By partnering with Tandem, we’re removing friction from both clinical and operational workflows—so clinicians can focus on getting patients the right treatments, faster. We’re excited to partner with Tandem who has a similar mission to OpenEvidence to build great technology products and improve doctors' end to end experience, and ultimately drive the best patient outcomes.” “As a practicing physician, I've seen how often the best treatment plans for patients are blocked by administrative complexity,” said Adam Harris, MD, Head of Clinical Intelligence at Tandem. “OpenEvidence helps clinicians make the right call. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Together, we're closing a gap that has undercut doctors and limited patients for too long.” By unifying clinical intelligence with execution, OpenEvidence and Tandem are helping ensure that treatments reach patients faster, more reliably, and with less burden on providers. Together they are redefining how care is delivered. Tandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treatment faster, medical staff get their time back, and providers can prescribe what they believe is best. Embedded directly into EHR workflows, Tandem automates every prior authorization from prescription to approval—generating appeals, routing prescriptions to the right pharmacy, and enrolling patients in savings and support programs to prev

evidence.text: OpenEvidence powers the clinical decision backed by evidence and Tandem automates every step from prescription to patient MIAMI, FL and NEW YORK, NY — April 2, 2026 — OpenEvidence, the leader in AI-powered medical search and clinical decision support, and Tandem, the leader closing the gap between breakthrough medications and patient access, today announced a strategic partnership to dramatically accelerate how patients access lifesaving medications. The result is the elimination of delays for doctors and patients between diagnosis and treatment. OpenEvidence empowers clinicians with real-time, continuously updated medical guidelines and research, enabling faster, more confident treatment decisions at the point of care. OpenEvidence powers more than 1 million clinical consultations per day in the United States alone, from logged-in verified clinicians. Tandem turns those decisions into action, including automating prior authorizations and appeals, ensuring patient affordability, and routing each prescription to the preferred pharmacy or site of care, at no cost to providers or patients. Tandem makes sure patients get the medicine they need. Tandem is the AI-powered network automating prescription access so patients get life-changing treatment faster, medical staff get their time back, and providers can prescribe what they believe is best.
